_notes._shared: Single source of truth for the simulated hives, mounted read-only (PROFILES_PATH) in both the simulator and the backfill. The simulator only reads tare_kg and reserves_kg; the remaining fields drive the backfill.
_notes.tare_kg: Weight of the empty hive plus bees: a weaker colony has fewer bees, hence a lower tare. Reserves (honey and pollen stores) = weight - tare_kg: the forecasting step uses it to estimate when the stores run out.
_notes.reserves_kg: CURRENT reserves, i.e. when the live simulation starts. Initial weight of the live hive = tare_kg + reserves_kg; the backfill anchors the end of the history to the same value.
_notes.strength: Colony strength, 1.0 = strong. Scales foraging, flights and nectar income.
_notes.flow_scale: Scales the nectar income of the hive (quality of the foraging area).
_notes.consumption_scale: Scales the colony's own consumption of stores.
_notes.honey_harvest_kg: Honey removed in one morning on harvest_day (MM-DD).
_notes.autumn_feeding_kg: Syrup given between Sep 15 and Sep 18.
